description:
**Now supports the free rif is fun app** (`com.andrewshu.android.reddit`) as well as golden platinum. The same bundle and link work for both.

Add it in ReVanced Manager as a remote patch bundle:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes/main/bundles/stable.json`

Patches: Fix Reddit galleries, Fix load more comments, Fix Redgifs, Fix imgur album thumbnails, Fix imgur title links. Patch your **original** rif 5.6.22 APK (free or golden platinum) together with the official **Spoof client** patch, and MojiRS's rif patches if you like (they include Disable ads for the free app). Golden platinum results are unchanged from v1.0.1.
